Housekeeping Manpower Services

Security Guard Services

Supply of trained, disciplined, and verified security guards for offices, banks, residential societies, industrial units, and Government establishments with 24×7 operational support.

Statutory Compliance Management

Attendance & Workforce Management

Recruitment & Onboarding Services

Reliable contract staffing solutions with personnel deployed on our payroll, ensuring flexibility, compliance, and continuity of operations for clients across sectors

Third-Party Payroll Management

Complete third-party payroll management services covering salary processing, wage disbursement, payslips, statutory deductions, and payroll compliance for contract and outsourced staff
